1: // Simple asteroid dodge game targeting canvas with id="game" with enhanced graphics
2: 
3: (() => {
4:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
5:   if (!canvas) return; // canvas not found
6:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
7:   const width = canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth;
8:   const height = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight;
9:   // create star field for background
10:   for (let i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
11:     stars.push({ x: rand(0, width), y: rand(0, height), radius: rand(0.5, 2) });
12:   }
13:   // Audio setup
14:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
15:   let thrustOsc = null;
16:   function startThrustSound() {
17:     if (thrustOsc) return;
18:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
19:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
20:     osc.frequency.value = 200;
21:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime);
22:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.07, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.02);
23:     osc.connect(gain).connect(audioCtx.destination);
24:     osc.start();
25:     thrustOsc = { osc, gain };
26:   }
27:   function stopThrustSound() {
28:     if (!thrustOsc) return;
29:     const { osc, gain } = thrustOsc;
30:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.1);
31:     setTimeout(() => {
32:       osc.stop();
33:     }, 120);
34:     thrustOsc = null;
35:   }
36:   function playExplosionSound() {
37:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
38:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
39:     osc.frequency.value = 80;
40:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.2, audioCtx.currentTime);
41:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.3);
42:     osc.connect(gain).connect(audioCtx.destination);
43:     osc.start();
44:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + 0.3);
45:   }
46: 
47: 
48:   // ----- Game State -----
49:   const ship = {
50:     x: width / 2,
51:     y: height / 2,
52:     angle: 0, // radians, 0 points up
53:     velX: 0,
54:     velY: 0,
55:     radius: 10,
56:   };
57:   const keys = { ArrowLeft: false, ArrowRight: false, ArrowUp: false };
58:   const asteroids = [];
59:   const stars = [];
60:   let gameOver = false;
61:   let spawnTimer = 0;
62: 
63: 
64:   // ----- Input -----
65:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
66:     if (keys.hasOwnProperty(e.key)) {
67: +      // Resume audio context on first interaction
68: +      if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume();
69: +      // start thrust sound when thrust begins
70: +      if (e.key === 'ArrowUp' && !keys.ArrowUp) startThrustSound();
71: +      keys[e.key] = true;
72: +    }
73: +  });
74: +  window.addEventListener('keyup', e => {
75: +    if (keys.hasOwnProperty(e.key)) {
76: +      // stop thrust sound when key released
77: +      if (e.key === 'ArrowUp' && keys.ArrowUp) stopThrustSound();
78: +      keys[e.key] = false;
79: +    }
80: +  });
81: 
82:   // ----- Helpers -----
83:   function rand(min, max) { return Math.random() * (max - min) + min; }
84:   function distance(ax, ay, bx, by) { return Math.hypot(ax - bx, ay - by); }
85:   // small particles for explosion effects
86:   const particles = [];
87:   function createExplosion(x, y) {
88:     const count = 20;
89:     for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
90:       particles.push({
91:         x,
92:         y,
93:         vx: rand(-2, 2),
94:         vy: rand(-2, 2),
95:         alpha: 1,
96:         size: rand(2, 4),
97:       });
98:     }
99:   }
100: 
101:   function spawnAsteroid() {
102:     // spawn on random edge
103:     const edge = Math.floor(rand(0, 4));
104:     let x, y, vx, vy;
105:     const speed = rand(1, 3);
106:     if (edge === 0) { // top
107:       x = rand(0, width); y = -20; vx = rand(-1, 1); vy = speed;
108:     } else if (edge === 1) { // right
109:       x = width + 20; y = rand(0, height); vx = -speed; vy = rand(-1, 1);
110:     } else if (edge === 2) { // bottom
111:       x = rand(0, width); y = height + 20; vx = rand(-1, 1); vy = -speed;
112:     } else { // left
113:       x = -20; y = rand(0, height); vx = speed; vy = rand(-1, 1);
114:     }
115:     const radius = rand(8, 20);
116:     asteroids.push({ x, y, vx, vy, radius });
117:   }
118: 
119:   function update(dt) {
120:     if (gameOver) return;
121:     // ship controls
122:     if (keys.ArrowLeft) ship.angle -= 0.07;
123:     if (keys.ArrowRight) ship.angle += 0.07;
124:     const thrusting = keys.ArrowUp;
125:     if (thrusting) {
126:       const thrust = 0.1;
127:       ship.velX += Math.sin(ship.angle) * thrust;
128:       ship.velY -= Math.cos(ship.angle) * thrust;
129:     }
130:     // apply friction
131:     ship.velX *= 0.99; ship.velY *= 0.99;
132:     // move ship
133:     ship.x += ship.velX;
134:     ship.y += ship.velY;
135:     // wrap around edges
136:     if (ship.x < 0) ship.x += width;
137:     if (ship.x > width) ship.x -= width;
138:     if (ship.y < 0) ship.y += height;
139:     if (ship.y > height) ship.y -= height;
140: 
141:     // spawn asteroids
142:     spawnTimer -= dt;
143:     if (spawnTimer <= 0) { spawnAsteroid(); spawnTimer = rand(0.5, 1.5); }
144: 
145:     // move asteroids
146:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
147:       const a = asteroids[i];
148:       a.x += a.vx; a.y += a.vy;
149:       // remove if far off-screen
150:       if (a.x < -50 || a.x > width + 50 || a.y < -50 || a.y > height + 50) {
151:         asteroids.splice(i, 1);
152:         continue;
153:       }
154:       // collision with ship
155:       if (distance(a.x, a.y, ship.x, ship.y) < a.radius + ship.radius) {
156:         createExplosion(ship.x, ship.y);
157:         playExplosionSound();
158:         gameOver = true;
159:       }
160:     }
161: 
162:     // update particles (explosion)
163:     for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
164:       const p = particles[i];
165:       p.x += p.vx;
166:       p.y += p.vy;
167:       p.alpha -= dt * 2;
168:       if (p.alpha <= 0) {
169:         particles.splice(i, 1);
170:       }
171:     }
172: 
173:     // twinkle stars (slight radius jitter)
174:     for (const s of stars) {
175:       s.radius += (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.02;
176:       if (s.radius < 0.3) s.radius = 0.3;
177:       if (s.radius > 2) s.radius = 2;
178:     }
179:   }
180: 
181:   function drawShip() {
182:     ctx.save();
183:     ctx.translate(ship.x, ship.y);
184:     ctx.rotate(ship.angle);
185:     // ship body with gradient
186:     const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, -ship.radius, 0, ship.radius);
187:     grad.addColorStop(0, '#0f0');
188:     grad.addColorStop(1, '#070');
189:     ctx.fillStyle = grad;
190:     ctx.beginPath();
191:     ctx.moveTo(0, -ship.radius);
192:     ctx.lineTo(ship.radius, ship.radius);
193:     ctx.lineTo(-ship.radius, ship.radius);
194:     ctx.closePath();
195:     ctx.fill();
196:     // thrust flame
197:     if (keys.ArrowUp) {
198:       ctx.fillStyle = 'orange';
199:       ctx.beginPath();
200:       ctx.moveTo(0, ship.radius);
201:       ctx.lineTo(ship.radius * 0.5, ship.radius + 10);
202:       ctx.lineTo(-ship.radius * 0.5, ship.radius + 10);
203:       ctx.closePath();
204:       ctx.fill();
205:     }
206:     ctx.restore();
207:   }
208: 
209:   function draw() {
210:     // Space background
211:     const bgGradient = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, height);
212:     bgGradient.addColorStop(0, '#001');
213:     bgGradient.addColorStop(1, '#000');
214:     ctx.fillStyle = bgGradient;
215:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
216: 
217:     // Stars (twinkling)
218:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
219:     for (const s of stars) {
220:       ctx.beginPath();
221:       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
222:       ctx.fill();
223:     }
224: 
225:     // Asteroids with radial gradient shading
226:     for (const a of asteroids) {
227:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(a.x, a.y, a.radius * 0.2, a.x, a.y, a.radius);
228:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#bbb');
229:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#555');
230:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
231:       ctx.beginPath();
232:       ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
233:       ctx.fill();
234:     }
235: 
236:     // Particles (explosion)
237:     for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
238:       const p = particles[i];
239:       ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,165,0,${p.alpha})`;
240:       ctx.beginPath();
241:       ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
242:       ctx.fill();
243:     }
244: 
245:     // Ship
246:     drawShip();
247: 
248:     if (gameOver) {
249:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
250:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
251:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
252:       ctx.font = '30px sans-serif';
253:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
254:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2, height / 2);
255:     }
256:   }
257: 
258:   let last = performance.now();
259:   function loop(now) {
260:     const dt = (now - last) / 1000; // seconds
261:     last = now;
262:     update(dt);
263:     draw();
264:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
265:   }
266:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
267: })();
